svg.title: Abdallah Atef portfolio preview
svg.desc: Dark portfolio homepage showing Abdallah Atef's introduction and About section.

g.text: Full Stack Developer who enjoys turning ideas into
things that actually work. I build, experiment, break,
I started programming four years ago out of curiosity — partly because I loved
games and wanted to understand how things were built, and partly because I wanted
to create something of my own. I started with C++, then found my way into web
development and eventually backend development with Node.js, Express, NestJS, and .NET.
Today, I'm still driven by building things and seeing how far I can take them.
